channel.title: GAMSA shortage alerts
channel.description: Gender-affirming medicines in Australia under a current TGA shortage notice. Rebuilt daily.

item.title: Discontinued (ARTG cancelled): Cyprostat (Cyproterone acetate 50 mg / 100 mg)
item.description: Permanently withdrawn by the sponsor: both strengths (50 mg, ARTG 156921, and 100 mg, ARTG 51450) were cancelled at Bayer's request from 16 June 2023. This is a discontinuation, not a temporary shortage. Patients on Cyprostat need an alternative brand or agent. Not returning. TGA status as checked 20 Oct 2026.

item.title: Limited availability: Estraderm MX 100 (100 mcg/24h patch)
item.description: The TGA shortage database lists Estraderm MX 100 as in limited supply until 30 October 2026. Estraderm MX 50 was resolved on 14 October 2026. Expected return: 30 Oct 2026. TGA status as checked 20 Oct 2026.

item.title: PBS access being extended (was due to end 1 Nov 2026): Zoladex 3.6mg (Goserelin monthly implant)
item.description: Zoladex 3.6 mg was due to leave the PBS on 1 November 2026. AstraZeneca has since told the TGA it will keep supplying it and extend PBS access, and it is not on the PBS deletions list for 1 November 2026; ask the pharmacist for the current position. This site will check this again after 1 November 2026. Triptorelin 3.75 mg (Diphereline) has had no PBS restriction since 1 October 2026, but its listing is not for use in gender dysphoria in minors. Expected return: access change, not a manufacturing shortage. TGA status as checked 20 Oct 2026.
